props.name: options
props.description: List of options to display in the dropdown

props.name: groups
props.description: List of option groups to display in the dropdown (alternative to options)

props.name: selected
props.description:
Currently selected option(s).
- For single select: a single T or null
- For multi-select: T[]

props.name: size
props.description: Size scale of the SelectBox component (`"sm"` | `"md"` | `"lg"`). Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: labelKey
props.description: Name of the field inside option objects to use as the label (defaults to "label")

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Name of the field inside option objects to use as the value (defaults to "value")

props.name: label
props.description: Text label displayed above the component

props.name: labelWrapperClass
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the label wrapper

props.name: labelClass
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the label element

props.name: labelHint
props.description: Optional hint element (string or JSX) displayed beside the label

props.name: containerClass
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer container

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text displayed when no value is selected

props.name: dropdownContainerClass
props.description: CSS classes applied to the dropdown options container

props.name: modalDropdown
props.description: Whether the open dropdown traps focus and makes the rest of the page inert.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Enable multiple selection mode

props.name: maxSelection
props.description: Maximum number of selections allowed in multi-select mode

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: Automatically renders a "Select All" / "Clear All" action header inside multi-select dropdowns.

props.name: immediate
props.description: Whether to commit value selection immediately when clicking options.

props.name: showErrorMessage
props.description: Whether to show an error message below the field

props.name: error
props.description: Error message displayed below the component

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper guidance message rendered below the field

props.name: leftGroup
props.description: Optional icon or element displayed on the left side of the input

props.name: renderOption
props.description: Custom option renderer function

props.name: async
props.description:
Enables async search mode:
- Component will not filter options locally
- Calls onSearch(query) when user types

props.name: onSearch
props.description:
Async search callback.
Should update the `options` prop externally after fetching.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Whether the user can type inside the input (false = readOnly mode)

props.name: required
props.description: Mark input as required (used for accessibility)

props.name: allowAdd
props.description: Whether to show an “Add new” option when no results match

props.name: addNewText
props.description: Label prefix for the “Add new” action (e.g., "Create")

props.name: noOptionsText
props.description:
Message shown in the dropdown when `options` is empty and the user
hasn't typed a search query yet.

props.name: onAdd
props.type: (value: string) => string | void | BaseOption | Promise<string | void | BaseOption>
props.raw: (value: string) => string | void | BaseOption | Promise<string | void | BaseOption>
props.description: Callback when the user chooses the "create/add" option.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show a clear (X) button for single-select mode

props.name: allowFreeText
props.description:
Allows typing freeform text that is not present in the options list.
Commits typed text as selected value on Enter or Blur.

props.name: asBottomSheet
props.description: Renders the select dropdown as a mobile-optimized slide-up bottom sheet

props.name: mobileMode
props.description: Mobile presentation mode (`"dropdown"` or `"sheet"`)
